needed.evidence: No footway present on the right side, pedestrians must walk in the roadway.
needed.suggestion: Install a continuous, usable sidewalk along the right side of the road to provide a safe walking space for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Obstructions on the left footway, partly blocking pedestrian movement.
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions and ensure the left footway is clear and fully accessible for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Uneven sections on the left footway that pose trip hazards.
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the uneven sections of the left footway to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: Pedestrian crossing demand is present, but no crossing facility is visible.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing at this location to facilitate safe crossing for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Street lighting is limited along the road.
needed.suggestion: Install additional street lights to improve visibility and safety along the road, especially in the evening and night.
